# Practice Runtime V2

`ms-go-practice-runtime` owns durable Practice V2 TaskInstances, immutable
Submissions and ValidationRuns, official results, human review, completion, and
Student evidence delivery. The ownership and wire contracts are documented in
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) and
[`contracts/practice-runtime-v2.md`](contracts/practice-runtime-v2.md).

## Status

Architecture is accepted and implementation is complete. Unit, contract,
PostgreSQL integration, and architecture-boundary checks are verified. Live
acceptance scenarios A–H are deferred because Docker Desktop was unavailable
during the isolated acceptance attempt; they have not passed.

## Local checks

```sh
./.ai/scripts/check-agent-policy.sh
gofmt -l $(rg --files -g '*.go' cmd internal)
go test ./...
go vet ./...
go build ./...
```

The separately approved PostgreSQL integration suite is declared in
`.ai/commands.yaml`. Operational behavior and recovery guidance are in
[`docs/operations.md`](docs/operations.md).
